If you are an actor, businessperson, interpreter, teacher, diplomat, or just wanting to expand your ability to mimic Americans for whatever reason, these classes are for you. As we learn the different theories in the book, we will do additional practice with my own materials for the section covered in the book with the aid of my own phonemic writing system. Although we will go linearly through the course, you will learn and practice things that are covered and emphasized in previous and following sections. Once we have finished the first three chapters, we can do a wide range of activities and be creative and personalized in how we practice that will continually change your accent to be ever more Californian. 
My other goals as a tutor are to be your native speaker connection, answer any questions you might have, share resources, encourage you, give you study tips, teach you slang/idioms/expressions, and get you to continue improving your abilities with English. You will receive access to over $100 of materials just for taking one class with me. I will also share with you other resources to practice.
